Position the sharp multi-arm Airy law explicitly against accepted-bank exp_multiarm_secondorder_minimax_frontier_v1, which established this unrestricted game's first-order value, n^-4/3 rate, and certificate framework but left the sharp coefficient, convergence, and q-star second-order optimality open.
proof_attempt_summary: The run developed the response-alphabet gauge, a full-dimensional exact-target tube, an all-count Bayes lower-bound route, and an effective-certificate construction for the proposed universal Airy coefficient. The typed novelty gate nevertheless graded the result incremental: the accepted parent already owns the first-order value, n^-4/3 rate, and certificate framework, while the new coefficient, convergence, and q-star optimality were not positioned and verified strongly enough to clear field. The archived solve artifacts preserve the mixed-sign witness, all-count argument, lower bound, and certificate work for a future re-raised proposal.
tldr: For every fixed \(K\ge2\) and every zero-sum, \(\ell^1\)-normalized contrast, the unrestricted binary finite-population game has risk \(R_n^{\{0,1\}}(c)=n^{-1}-C_AV_c(s_c/2)^{2/3}n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3})\). For every fixed finite \(L<U\), the bounded-outcome game is exactly \(R_n^{[L,U]}(c)=(U-L)^2R_n^{\{0,1\}}(c)\). The same contrast-weighted independent assignment attains the scaled expansion with a total Rao--Blackwellized nonlinear Airy rule. The published two-arm binary and bounded results are the support-two anchors; the new geometry is the response-alphabet and all-allocation-face closure for contrasts with at least three active coordinates. Rational contrasts and rational endpoints admit terminating exact all-future certificates; rational bracketing transfers the mathematics, but not Turing evaluation, to unrepresented reals.
gap: Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2026), Theorems 2.2 and 3.1, solve the unrestricted binary two-arm game through a scalar ancillary experiment and an Airy least-favorable prior. Hull (2026), Theorem 1, independently reduces the bounded two-arm game. Neither construction handles a signed contrast with a multidimensional nuisance kernel, a response alphabet of size \(2^{|S_c|}\), or allocation faces that omit an active arm.
fill: The paper will prove the Airy headline on the explicit union of the published normalized two-arm class and the new at-least-three-active-arm class, with the two-arm reduction as the bridge; identify \(C_AV_c(s_c/2)^{2/3}\); construct the explicit independent design and nonlinear estimator on the new component; and provide a finite proof-checkable certificate record with a total exact per-sample-size evaluator for rational inputs. The central open content is the exact-target weak integration-by-parts inequality and its uniform local, exterior, inactive-arm, and zero-count remainder control.
